description: This file defines the ICatalogItemService interface in C#, which declares asynchronous methods for managing catalog items including creation, editing, deletion, retrieval, and listing.

classes.name: ICatalogItemService
classes.description: Defines service operations for catalog items such as create, edit, delete, get by ID, and list.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Creates a new catalog item asynchronously.

methods.name: Edit
methods.description: Edits an existing catalog item asynchronously.

methods.name: Delete
methods.description: Deletes a catalog item by ID asynchronously.

methods.name: GetById
methods.description: Retrieves a catalog item by its ID asynchronously.

methods.name: ListPaged
methods.description: Lists catalog items with pagination support asynchronously.
